title: Brand Evolution / Connectivity Current
slide_intent: Extend an established color identity deliberately so people can recognize continuity while noticing a new expression.
strategic_value: Retaining a deep blue field while adding green can give Spectrum a more distinctive signal without abandoning its blue heritage.
demonstration: Blue-to-green curved lines sweep across a dark blue field and converge toward the lower right; the white logo and Life Unlimited tagline occupy the upper-right corner.
practical_value: Use the familiar color as the field and assess how a new accent changes the character of the supporting graphic.

content_islands.name: Connectivity current
content_islands.spec: Draw the curved line family across the full width, entering from the left, converging below center-right and continuing beyond the right edge.

content_islands.name: Brand signature
content_islands.spec: Place the Spectrum mark and Life Unlimited tagline on one line at upper right, separate from the current.

ingredient.name: Connectivity current color
ingredient.role: Make the flowing graphic conspicuous while keeping the field recognizably Spectrum.
ingredient.application: Pair the blue-forward identity with vivid green in the current, predominantly over deep blue, as described by the agency.
ingredient.scope: The Life Unlimited evolution documented in the agency’s January 2025 case study. No exact color values or mandatory proportions are supplied.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying Thornberg & Forester case study explains that green differentiates Spectrum while the retained blue connects the evolution to its existing identity.
reference_purposes.Expression: Blue-to-green current lines cross a deep blue field beneath the Spectrum and Life Unlimited signature.
reference_purposes.Application: The hero artwork demonstrates the current and signature together; the agency describes deep blue as the current’s usual backplate, not a mandatory background for every execution.
